location_transition.closure: deny new occurrences; drain or explicitly transfer in-flight work
location_transition.split_merge: new identities plus explicit impact commands

ownership.device_assignment: time-bounded record, never rewrites original actor
ownership.reassignment: new assignment generation; prior offline commands retain captured actor/session/grant

occurrence.next_occurrence: derived once from committed completion identity

session.concurrency: one active completing session per occurrence
session.crash: lease expiry permits explicit recovery without actor substitution

offline.sync: reauthorize transport only; never replace original authorization
offline.stale: generation matrix then reject or quarantine

cross_domain_effects: tickets and inspections reference stable IDs
rollback preserves original actor and sequence
